findings.passage: It is misguided to crack down on gun owners who honor our laws and act in good faith instead of going after the real criminals. I do not support that approach and will continue opposing these bills.
findings.note: Her legislative update on HF 601 (reporting lost and stolen firearms) and HF 4300 (firearm storage). She opposes both. The date is taken from the page's own date reference and may be a day or so off.

findings.passage: On the other hand, I do support solutions to help us get to the root of gun violence. For example, House Republicans are sponsoring legislation to increase penalties for so-called “straw purchases” where someone who is eligible to purchase a firearm purchases one for someone who may be prohibited from doing so.
findings.note: In the same update she says she supports higher penalties for straw purchases.
subjects: straw purchases
who may have a gun

findings.passage: We have absolutely taken votes; they just haven’t turned in the way that we’re hearing some people want.
findings.note: Quoted in a House Session Daily story. As Speaker she says House committees voted on the gun bills now in the Senate-passed package (HF3874/SF4067, which includes an assault-weapon and large-magazine sale ban), and they failed. She did not release that bill to the floor.
subjects: ban on assault-style guns and large magazines
